facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Hans had nothing. But he was happy. He felt light. Hans felt free.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans had nothing left but he was smiling brightly. He stretched his arms and looked up at the blue sky. Hans felt free without anything heavy to carry. He danced and sang as he walked down the road. No gold, no horse, no cow, but pure happiness. He realized that freedom was the greatest treasure.
